QuestionStmt.S: Identify a molecule having highest number of lone pair of electrons in valence shell of central atom.

Solution.S:
Number of lone pairs on central atom:

- $\mathrm{NH_3}$: N has 1 lone pair.
- $\mathrm{SF_4}$: S has 1 lone pair.
- $\mathrm{ICl_3}$: I has 2 lone pairs.
- $\mathrm{PCl_3}$: P has 1 lone pair.

Thus $\mathrm{ICl_3}$ has the highest number (2) of lone pairs on the central atom, corresponding to option C.
